title: Piercing Frame Solo #016 (임산부 허리 컷 · P100 정의형 · 임산부 · 공예 Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework · 체형 임산부USSBBW · 메이크업 히메갸루 · 금속 혼합)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, waist shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head down to just below her pregnant belly, the frame cutting off beneath the belly. Her face sits in the upper part of the frame, large enough to read every piercing, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, a sweet princess-like smile, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in elegant updo. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. Her neck, the hollows above her collarbones and the tops of her shoulders carry the same real living skin as her face: visible pores and fine skin grain, a soft sheen of natural skin oils on the highest planes, faint fine peach-fuzz hairs catching the rim light along the neck and shoulder line, gentle tonal variation with a natural warm flush at the base of the neck and across the collarbones, and the fine natural creases of a real neck — never airbrushed, never smooth like plastic.

Piercings: An extreme, dense armour of about one hundred real mixed-metal piercings with a few mixed-metal coin drops among them covering the face: a thick mixed-metal septum ring with a smaller ring above it and two mixed-metal rings through each nostril; a straight mixed-metal bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; five thick mixed-metal bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; two rows of four small mixed-metal studs across the forehead above the brows; four small studs up each temple on the bone, well clear of the eyes; a row of six small studs along each cheekbone; a mixed-metal Medusa stud above the lips; a big mixed-metal hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and five small hoops along the upper lip's edge; a mixed-metal labret stud and four rings through the chin; five small studs along each jaw; on each ear a full dense row of ten oversized hoops, thick bars, stretched plugs, helix rings and studs from lobe to top, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and eight fine mixed-metal chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings and the septum ring. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. All jewelry is real mixed metal (yellow gold, silver, copper and rose gold, alternating piece by piece), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is painted in one traditional pattern: Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework (a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs), wide cream bands following the contours of the body, with concentric ripple linework filling the space between bands, covering every inch of skin from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the pattern reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. The bands of the pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it is the body treatment described above.

Pose: standing tall, one hand cradling the underside of her belly and the other relaxed at her side, head level toward the camera.

Lighting: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
